claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the current release can be certified on a narrow basis because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and the packet can rely on public governance guidance so long as the current fraud dispute review regression is explicitly disclosed as a material limitation.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed acceptance.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient if the disclosure predicate is unresolved.
evidence_requests: Produce the current release model card or audit packet showing the fraud dispute review weakness disclosed as a material limitation for the named launch use case.
Produce any approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation that covers the current subgroup regression.
Produce the final current-release certification record demonstrating documentation has been updated to reflect the current eval batch.
specific_concerns: The admissible record supports a conditional path to certification, not present-tense certification itself.

Policy requires the current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose the material subgroup weakness unless there is approved risk acceptance, but no finalized disclosure artifact is in evidence.
The informal monitoring comment is explicitly unsupported by reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or attached disclosure language.
Prior approval of the same model family predates the current retrieval change and current eval batch, so it cannot carry the current release.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently evidentially complete, rather than only potentially supportable after the documentation is updated.
That the existing record contains the required current model-card disclosure or approved mitigation for the fraud dispute review regression.
Any implication that prior approval or the monitoring comment meaningfully closes the current policy gap.
